verdict: Archive identity, source, size, digest, authorization handling and success-gated upload logic look correct on source inspection. One timing caveat: the claimed 480-second overall deadline is only a cooperative transfer check, not a strict wall-clock bound. No byte preservation or test-integrity defect found.

findings.title: 480-second check is not an overall hard deadline
findings.source: started is initialized after API validation, and elapsed time is checked only before response.read(1 MiB). opener.open and response.read block independently; no elapsed check follows the final EOF read.
findings.reproductionReasoning: An operation may begin just below 480 seconds and block past the boundary. In particular, if the final read returns EOF after crossing the limit, the loop breaks and digest verification/receipt generation can succeed without another deadline check. This is static control-flow reasoning, not an executed timing reproduction.
findings.consequence: The workflow remains bounded by its 12-minute GitHub job timeout and socket timeouts, but cannot honestly claim a strict 480-second overall duration.
findings.recommendation: If 480 seconds is required, enforce a process-level deadline covering the intended phase; otherwise describe this as a cooperative transfer check and the 12-minute job timeout as the hard overall bound.

checks.result: Fetched commit adds only the 129-line preservation workflow and nine-line request. No app/test source is changed by this candidate.

Request is bounded to 8 KiB; runId must be a positive actual int below 2^63; sourceRevision a forty-hex string; one to four unique artifactNames must exactly match allowlisted UI evidence/full or compact names. Initial request selects two library-reference archives from source 75e827f2ee3f99798d619aff62f3a5188b509428.

REST URL root is fixed to api.github.com/repos/GITHUB_REPOSITORY; request cannot supply a host or arbitrary path. Original run head_sha and repository are checked. The run-scoped listing must fit one 100-item page; exactly one unexpired match is required per requested name, with matching artifact workflow_run.head_sha.

Downloads use each verified artifact ID, not a second name lookup. SHA256 metadata must be present and well-formed. Every streamed byte is hashed; final byte count and SHA256 must exactly equal GitHub metadata before a receipt is produced.

Declared sizes must be positive ints <=512 MiB each and <=1 GiB combined. Streams use 1 MiB chunks; bytes exceeding the declared size fail before writing that chunk. A new fixed directory and exclusive-create artifact-ID ZIP filenames are used. No archive extraction, image conversion or content modification occurs.

The custom redirect handler rejects non-HTTPS redirect destinations and removes Authorization from the Request returned by the standard redirect handler. The token is only supplied to the original fixed GitHub API call; code does not print it. Actual redirect/network behavior has not been executed by this reviewer.

The upload step has default success gating, with no always() or continue-on-error. Any missing/ambiguous artifact, expiry, size mismatch, digest mismatch, network exception or transfer deadline failure makes the preceding step fail and prevents upload. On success the folder contains exact verified ZIPs and a receipt. compression-level: 0 packages the original files without changing their contents.

Only contents: read and actions: read are requested. Existing github.token is used; no new secrets or write grants. Source-level indentation, heredoc, loops, context managers and output references are coherent. No parser/interpreter was executed.

Actually fetched candidate iOS workflow: push has branches-ignore: ['m03-evidence-inspection']; pull_request has no matching branch exemption. This supports a push of the preservation workflow to that diagnostic branch without restarting the main iOS run. Restoration before any main integration remains a future action, not verified here.

Read-only API checks corroborate the requested run and two archives. Run 45751931160 was on main, source 75e827f2ee3f99798d619aff62f3a5188b509428, attempt 1 and in_progress when read. Listing contained 13 artifacts, including one unexpired match for each requested name; both fit all size/digest-format checks. No archive bytes were downloaded or verified here.

initialRequest.purpose: Keep the complete original failed library archives independently accessible before a focused same-source job retry.

limitations: This is unpublished-candidate source review plus read-only original-run/artifact metadata inspection.
Successful streaming, GitHub digest equality and independent artifact upload require actual execution; no preservation-success claim is made.
The 480-second limit is cooperative as described in the finding; the GitHub job timeout remains 12 minutes.
The planned later main snapshot/restoration and the asserted unchanged set of 190 tested blobs were not independently recomputed in this narrow review.
Artifact expiry/deletion before the preservation run will cause a visible failure rather than a substituted archive.
mutationScope: Only this authorized unreferenced JSON report blob is created; no source, branch, ref, tree or test mutations. Prior w097 reports and context count are preserved.
